phil-aes-01-c2.text: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy. Aesthetic Judgment. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
phil-aes-01-c2.quote: the discernment of aesthetic properties requires a special sensitivity
phil-aes-01-c2.claim: Frank Sibley argued in 'Aesthetic Concepts' (1959) that applying aesthetic terms correctly requires taste, a perceptual sensitivity.

phil-aes-04-c1.text: Adajian, Thomas (2007). The Definition of Art. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
phil-aes-04-c1.claim: Morris Weitz (1956) argued art is an open concept: there is no set of necessary and sufficient conditions for being art.
